project.name: SynLingo
project.audience: general public, educators, accessibility advocates, and potential users

hero.headline: Indian Sign Language, translated into real-time text.
hero.subheadline: SynLingo is an upcoming AI-powered web platform built to make everyday communication accessible and independent for the hearing- and speech-impaired community.

problemStatement.title: The communication gap is still a daily barrier.
problemStatement.body: In schools, clinics, offices, and public spaces, people who rely on ISL often face delays, misunderstandings, and dependence on intermediaries. SynLingo aims to reduce that friction through direct sign-to-text interaction in the browser.

features.name: Real-time computer vision translation
features.description: Detects and interprets ISL gestures in near real time to generate readable text output.

features.name: Visual hand-placement guidance
features.description: Provides live framing and hand-position cues to improve recognition quality and confidence.

features.name: Client-side privacy by design
features.description: No personal data is stored; processing is planned to remain browser-side for safer interaction.

aboutTeam.title: Built by students at APS Bhopal

status.headline: In active development
status.detail: The full SynLingo platform is currently being developed with a custom-trained ISL dataset and more advanced sentence formation.

cta.title: Accessibility should feel immediate.
cta.description: SynLingo is being designed for inclusive everyday conversation — from classrooms to customer counters.
